                                   id  The meter id number.
                                 name  Your name for the meter.
                                media  What does the meter measure?
                                meter  Meter driver.
                            timestamp  Timestamp when wmbusmeters received the telegram. Local time for hr/fields UTC for json.
                         timestamp_ut  Unix timestamp when wmbusmeters received the telegram.
                         timestamp_lt  Local time when wmbusmeters received the telegram.
                        timestamp_utc  UTC time when wmbusmeters received the telegram.
                               device  The wmbus device that received the telegram.
                             rssi_dbm  The rssi for the received telegram as reported by the device.
                             total_m3  The total media volume consumption recorded by this meter.
                            target_m3  The volume recorded by this meter at the target date.
                          target_date  The target date. Usually the end of the previous billing period.
                               status  Status and error flags.
                       current_status  Status of meter. This field will go away use status instead.
                             flow_m3h  The current flow of water through the meter.
                   flow_temperature_c  The water temperature.
min_external_temperature_last_month_c  The lowest external temperature outside of the meter during the last month.
  min_external_temperature_last_day_c  The lowest external temperature outside of the meter during the last day.
                         max_flow_m3h  The maximum flow recorded during previous period.
               min_flow_temperature_c  The minimum water temperature.
               max_flow_temperature_c  The maximum water temperature.
           max_external_temperature_c  The maximum temperature recorded during previous period.
                         min_flow_m3h  The minimum flow recorded during previous period.
                             time_dry  Amount of time the meter has been dry.
                        time_reversed  Amount of time the meter has been reversed.
                         time_leaking  Amount of time the meter has been leaking.
                        time_bursting  Amount of time the meter has been bursting.
